findings.text: Outro music jumps from about -44 dB to -15 dB RMS within 30 ms when the end card appears (short-term loudness -35 to -22 LUFS, about 13 LU above the bed) and holds to the end; this is the one place it still 'gets louder', so ramp it over 0.5-1 s and/or cap it about 6 LU above the bed.

At the intro-to-bed seam the music fades to digital silence (1.42-1.56 s, exact zeros 1.520-1.555 s) and re-enters hard with no crossfade; it is masked under the word 'already' but is a real stop and restart.

Body bed is steady and unducked: 3-second block power -32.4 to -33.6 dB across 3-75 s, speech vs pause 0.8 dB apart, fitted music gain 0.96-0.99 throughout (rejected mix: 8.5 dB duck, about 9 dB swings).
The music has 150-200 ms rests at -52 to -63 dB about every 2-5 s (15 instances); all but one are under speech, the one at 16.1 s falls in a voice pause.
Bed short-term loudness steps down about 2 LU around 22-24 s (-33.3 to -35.5 LUFS) and stays there; gradual, not a swell.
Final mp4 is -14.0 LUFS integrated, -1.4 dBTP true peak, 3.9 LU loudness range; the ending is a 0.4 s fade to -55 dB, not a hard cut.

Voiceover ad-libs against the script in about eight places, including 'what I do with this information if I were you' (script: 'what I'd do with this info') and 'And at work,' replacing 'Does it matter at work?'.
The script path in the brief no longer exists; the post folder is now '2026-11-06 Fri mind.the.gap - Two passports'.
The '35% / Christian Science Monitor' stat band partly covers the passport code line ('1<OF<2'); unchanged picture the owner already accepted.
